messages:
maria: Quick question — when we generate the audit bundle for routing-policy changes, do we currently include quota-affing fields (eg. quota_bucket, quota_delta) in the exported events? Customers want to trace "who changed routing behavior that caused quota spikes" :thinking:
kevin: I don't think quota_delta is in the payload right now. We record policy diffs and the new routing table, but quota bookkeeping lives in a separate telemetry stream. That makes correlation painful.
eli: Agree. For compliance downloads we should attach minimal quota metadata to each change event: `quota_bucket`, `quota_scope`, and `applied_change` (increase/decrease). Could be optional (flagged) so we don't bloat small exports.
sara: UI ask: add a linkable anchor in the console proof explorer so legal can jump from an exported event to the exact rollout/route in the console. Otherwise they get an NDJSON file and no context.
maria: ^exactly. Also need to show whether the change was part of a canary rollout or manual edit. `rollout_id` + `rollout_stage` would help.
kevin: Thinking about schemas — if we add these fields, we should keep the top-level event shape unchanged and put extras under `event.extras` to avoid breaking existing parsers. e.g. `{..., "event.extras": {"quota_bucket":"x", "rollout_id":"r-123"}}`
eli: I prefer explicit top-level keys for the common ones (quota_bucket, rollout_id) and reserve `extras` for vendor-specific bits. Most consumers will look for those few keys.
sara: UX wins if the console shows a small badge: "affects quota" on the changecard. Then export just includes the boolean plus bucket id. Legal can expand details if needed.
maria: For exports retention/PII: we should not include operator email by default — instead include `operator_id` and an `actor_hint` like 'platform-admin'. For sensitive orgs, they can opt-in to full identity.
kevin: That maps to our existing redaction flags. Add an export-level param `identity_mode: [pseudonymize|full|none]`. Default pseudonymize.
eli: Also add `policy_version` and `policy_preimage_hash` so downstream auditors can verify the exact rule content without storing full rules in the main row.
maria: Action items: 1) kevin to propose event shape change (backwards-compatible) 2) eli to sketch console badge + anchor behavior 3) sara to prototype export param UI for identity_mode.
kevin: I'll open a tiny RFC and include an NDJSON sample and a migration plan. Should we also include a sample SQL join snippet for SOC teams to correlate telemetry.exports -> quota.stream?
sara: Please do. that'll speed adoption.
deploy-bot: deploy: audit-service v3.14.2 rolled out to prod at 2026-03-20T18:02:11Z :rocket:
maria: Nice — keep this small so we can ship before EOD. If anyone wants to pair on the RFC I'm around after standup. :pray:
